purpose: W0034 SC-02 probe matrix: PG und-x-icu vs JS (Node ICU 78.x / Unicode 17.0 / en-US) differences; generated, then reviewed; tests assert every row, never regenerate expectations

lower.rowExpansion: each row x fields x pageSizes; op=lower; query=js; expected sets: a contact holding the character in <field> is in the PG-path result iff expected[collversion].pgPathMatches and in the JS-path result iff jsPathMatches; literal-query anchors are always in both

sort.rowExpansion: each code point x fields; op=sort; page size 30 (home: top 3, sliding); within each batch of batchSize consecutive code points (ascending), the anchor rows must appear in pgBatchRank[collversion] order; jsBatchRank records the JS localeCompare order of the same anchors

orderSha256.description: sha256 of all assigned single-character strings (Unicode 17, excl. Co/Cs) joined by U+0000 in each order

review.lower: 95 rows, all capital letters added in Unicode 14 (40), 16 (27), 17 (28): Cyrillic TJE, Glagolitic caudate chrivi, Latin A7C0-A7DC additions, Vithkuqi, Garay, U+16EA0-16EB8; JS toLowerCase maps them, PG lower() on ICU 67 (153.14) leaves them unchanged; PG on ICU 78 (153.136) agrees with JS for every code point
review.sort: 19942 single characters whose PG und-x-icu 153.14 position differs from JS (ICU 78.2/78.3 give byte-identical orders): 15942 are all characters assigned in Unicode 14-17 (unassigned in ICU 67, implicit weights), 4000 are older characters reordered between CLDR 37 and 48 roots (e.g. Hebrew geresh, Bengali/Oriya/Malayalam fractions); PG 153.136 order equals JS order exactly
review.nodeVersions: generated with Node 24.21.0 (ICU 78.3) and Node 24.15.0 (ICU 78.2): identical lower rows, sort rows and order hashes
